articles.title: 'Shouting match', Trump, Netanyahu clash over future of Iran war: Report
articles.description: US President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu reportedly clashed over the war with Iran during a tense weekend phone call. articles.title: Strait of Hormuz will "never return" to pre-war status: Ghalibaf says "ball in US court" on peace talks
articles.description: Iran's Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf discussed the future management of the Strait of Hormuz with Oman. He emphasized that the waterway's regulations would change following the US-Israel war on Iran. Negotiations with the United States are contingent upon adhering to Iran's seven conditions.

articles.title: war status: Ghalibaf says "ball in US court" on peace talks
articles.description: Iran's Parliament Speaker and chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has said that the Strait of Hormuz will 'never return' to its pre-war status following the US-Israel war on Iran, asserting that Tehran and Oman have reached an understanding on overseeing the strategically important waterway.
